title: Aubrey Plaza's Very Filthy Housewarming Present of a David Choe Painting given to Conan O'Brien
summary: A 2:15 Conan-style host/guest clip in which Aubrey Plaza’s title-level appearance frames a story about a large nude painting on wood that she says David Choe gave her as a housewarming gift. She first calls it a naked picture of herself, then corrects that to a nude woman Choe reportedly said was her, describing “Asian eyes” and an unresolved feet-related alteration. She claims Choe was a thief and jailed for years while admitting she does not know what he stole; those remain unverified comedy-stage allegations, not biography. She says he contacted her as a fan, asked to bring a gift, arrived barefoot in a white suit, gave her the work, jumped in the pool and left. The host’s police-report framing is a joke, not evidence of a complaint. The painting later appears in a Thanksgiving/dining-room joke involving her mother. Every allegation, nude detail, racialized phrase and private-home anecdote remains uncensored. Title context identifies the public participants at source level, but captions do not prefix turns; zero named turns ship.
